rules.details: Product name, always written as PlanCake in Latin script
The command-line program name, always lowercase, in code formatting
Company name, always written in Latin script
Microsoft component name; WebView2 alone is also never translated
Markup language name, capitalized in every language
Screen reader product name, always uppercase
Screen reader product name, always uppercase
Default opening note marker, literal text in code formatting
Default closing note marker, literal text in code formatting

A language named in its own language (English, Русский, Українська, Français, עברית, Deutsch) inside text in another language is wrapped in , so a screen reader reads it with the right voice: Русский. Hebrew in a left-to-right manual also gets dir="rtl"; in the Hebrew manual, a left-to-right name gets dir="ltr". The name of the manual's own language needs no span.
